title: Open-bed Utility Pickup
description: Original S01 static utility pickup with a genuinely separate two-seat cab and open-top empty cargo bed. Cabin has actual open window apertures, supported seats, dashboard and a fixed steering visual; no glazing is claimed. The low-walled bed has a real interior floor, front bulkhead and fixed closed tailgate. Four finite-contact tyres, hubs, axles, hangers, chassis rails and floor bearers form actual support chains. Metre scale, source Z up, front -Y, origin at ground under the wheelbase centre. Five solid PBR materials and named editable closed components. One fixed parked visual prop; no driving, steering, opening tailgate or doors, animation, cargo capacity, loading fit, roadworthiness, collision, physics, stability, load or engineering certification.
